resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second character-design direction is the measured axis. Put its named face geometry and proportions on the visible subject. Translate its silhouette and layers into large asymmetric garment shapes, and repeat its seam curves and closures as front-readable clothing details. One adult full-length editorial photograph: thick chalk strokes and loose dry dust across the backdrop; two huge diagonal light slabs crossed behind the adult; amber and blue split across subject and set; a deep-black surround and one narrow light path; tack-sharp face and hands, defocused outer set border. Keep one human only, realistic skin, coherent hands, believable fabric, natural proportions, cinematic depth, and no text, logos, or watermarks. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult character has an asymmetric urban silhouette with offset layers and a clear uninterrupted body line, a long adult face with high cheekbones, a narrow nose bridge, and calm eyes, and naturally balanced body proportions with believable hands, feet, and joint placement. The design is unified by subtle botanical seam curves and leaflike closures used as controlled accents. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
